item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1_provider_opt_in","claim_type":"core","weight":32,"statement":"`LM.launch()` only delegates to the current provider, and DSPy does not infer `LocalProvider` from the model string: `infer_provider()` auto-selects `OpenAIProvider` only for OpenAI models and otherwise falls back to the base `Provider`, whose `launch()` method is a no-op. A local server is therefore launched only if the caller explicitly uses a provider with launch logic such as `LocalProvider`.","span_ids":["s1","s2","s3"]},{"claim_id":"c2_model_name_normalization","claim_type":"core","weight":18,"statement":"`LocalProvider.launch()` normalizes the model name before launch by stripping a leading `openai/`, `local:`, or `huggingface/` prefix and then using the remainder as the model path.","span_ids":["s4"]},{"claim_id":"c3_server_boot_command","claim_type":"core","weight":23,"statement":"For local launch, DSPy grabs a free localhost port and starts an SGLang server with `subprocess.Popen` using the argument vector `python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <model> --port <port> --host 0.0.0.0`.","span_ids":["s5"]},{"claim_id":"c4_readiness_and_lm_rewrite","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"After spawning the process, DSPy waits for readiness by polling `http://localhost:<port>/v1/models`;
